editorial.blurb: A elegant French Colonial Vietnamese gem that delivers gastronomic sophistication without the downtown price tag, with impeccable service and a serene terrace perfect for a leisurely evening.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Pasteur's Signature Beef Steak cooked medium and share appetizers family-style — the dumplings, egg rolls, spring rolls, and Saigon crêpes are all exceptional and let you experience the full range of flavors.
